description: #684 — dry-run a rule against one record before trusting it live. Omit `action_index` to just check whether the rule's condition matches this record and see which actions WOULD run (no side effects). Pass `action_index` to actually send that one http_request action for real — everything else is not currently testable this way.

action_index.description: Index into the rule's actions array — actually SENDS that http_request action. Omit for a side-effect-free condition check.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id.

record.description: Record uuid or public number to test against.
